verdict: Meta is delivering; Google has spent $813 with zero returns this period.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 152 leads at an average cost of $15.94 per lead — all of them from Meta, where a retargeting push drove a 44% surge in leads and a 21% drop in cost per lead over the past week alone. Google Ads ran $813.24 in spend over the same window and produced zero conversions, which has been confirmed and is being addressed through a budget reallocation review. On the pipeline side, 122 opportunities were created in your CRM but none have progressed to a won or appointment stage, pointing to a follow-up gap that is being investigated independently of ad performance. New landing pages and a fresh creative batch are due live by August 31, which should give the Meta campaigns stronger assets heading into September.
